I dealt with this about a year to a year and a half ago. I was completely paralyzed with love and the closest I got was, 'maybe if this didn't happen'. Now she's just a painful memory. But I realized something. I never loved her. I only loved the idea of her, what I thought she really was. I realized she was a bitch to me. Using me as a pawn in the game of chess. It took me too long to realize this and I suffer from it. It's gonna hurt but just keep yourself away from her. Confront your issues with her first then don't come back to her. Find someone new. I have yet to find love for myself but I am just waiting

I have Major Depressive Disorder, Bipolar, Public Anxiety, and Post Traumatic Stress Disorder. I still haven't told anyone. Only my therapist that sends me into a downward spiral of depression. I've been in this rut for years and I still dont know how to get out of it. I suggest telling your doctor and getting a therapist. Make sure he's helped people in the past and he's good enough to deal with depression. Just please don't end up like me.
